chunks: And Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
Ali, peace be upon him, said: "The right of pre-emption is according to the number of men."

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring here to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: a narrator in the sanad/isnad of this hadith
key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: men, by whose number the pre-emption right is determined in this wording
key_terms.الشُّفْعَةُ: the right of pre-emption in jointly held property
key_terms.جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام, transmitting the report
key_terms.عَدَدِ: number or count, indicating proportional determination
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, the speaker of the ruling

ai.seo_question: How is the right of pre-emption divided according to this hadith from Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle regarding shuf'ah, the right of pre-emption in shared property arrangements. It indicates that this right is determined in accordance with the number of participating men, making it relevant to questions of ownership and legal entitlement.
